title: fix(showcase): translate the task detail review banner under zh-CN
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"marchtian"} -->
_Requested by **田騏** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi?thread=cmsg_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi9paTx1Lu8ENYwwssthfK3h)_

Fixes #28982
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读
- 改了什么：showcase 任务详情页顶部的「待评审」黄色提示条在中文会话下改为中文——标题走翻译包，正文用页面上的内联多语言文本。
- 为什么改：中文用户打开评审中的任务，整页都是中文，唯独这条提示是英文，像没翻完；发版清单 i18n.notification-localized-and-clears 的 A1（不得中英混排）因此一直红。
- 风险与回滚：只动示例应用，不发布任何包；提示条的「关闭记忆」改用固定键，之前关掉过它的人会再看到一次；回滚即还原本 PR。
- 先看：`examples/app-showcase/src/ui/pages/task-detail.page.ts`（record:alert 节点的 id、body、dismissKey）→ `examples/app-showcase/src/system/translations/index.ts`（zh-CN 的 pages.showcase_task_detail）→ 新测试文件。
- 两分钟验证：`pnpm --filter @objectstack/example-showcase exec vitest run test/task-detail-review-alert-zh-cn.test.ts`，预期 3 passed；或中文会话打开种子任务「Design system」，提示条显示「待评审」和中文正文。
- 需要你做的：无，席位落地。

## What changes

The Task Detail page (`showcase_task_detail`) shows a `record:alert` banner while a task is in review. On a zh-CN session it rendered in English because the node had no component `id`, and page component copy is translated through `pages.NAME.components.COMPONENT_ID.KEY`.

- `task-detail.page.ts`: the banner gets `id: 'review_alert'` (snake_case, like the page ids elsewhere in the showcase: `new_project_form`, `project_picker`).
- `translations/index.ts`: the zh-CN bundle gains `pages.showcase_task_detail.components.review_alert.title` = 待评审. The `en` block carries no `pages` entries, and the authored English stays the default text. The showcase ships `en` and `zh-CN` only (`objectstack.config.ts` `supportedLocales`), so no other locale needs the key.
- **`body` does not go through the bundle, because the bundle has no key for it.** The page-component copy face is `title / description / label / placeholder / emptyText` (`PAGE_COMPONENT_COPY_KEYS`, `packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts`), and the bundle schema is strict there. Measured on the built spec: an entry with only `title` parses, and one with `title` plus `body` is refused with `unrecognized_keys` ("Unrecognized key(s) on this page component translation: `body`"). `RecordAlertProps.body` is declared `I18nLabelSchema`, and the renderer reads it through `pickLocalized`, so the body is now an inline locale map holding both `en` and `zh-CN`. This follows the recorded precedent for `element:text` `content` in `translation.zod.ts`: the inline locale map is the ruled route for page prose, and that shape was not added to the bundle.
- `dismissKey: 'showcase_task_review'`: the dismissal key defaults to the English resolution of `title`. Once the bundle translates the title, a zh-CN session would resolve that key to the translation, so a banner dismissed in one locale would come back in the other. The key is now fixed.

## Tests

- New pin: `examples/app-showcase/test/task-detail-review-alert-zh-cn.test.ts`. It applies `translateMetadataDocument('page', …)` to the page with the app's own bundle, which is the same thing the REST boundary does for each request locale. It asserts the zh-CN title, that the body's locale map comes back intact, the fixed `dismissKey`, the English title under `en`, and that the zh-CN bundle still parses under `TranslationBundleSchema`. Its model is `zh-cn-report-blocks-inline-titles.test.ts`.
- Reverse check, run once: with the two source files restored to base `ab085a0482` and the test kept, the pin goes red (`expected undefined to be 'review_alert'`, 1 failed and 2 passed). Restored from `HEAD`, `git diff HEAD` is empty.

## Acceptance notes

- The card listed `title/body` under the bundle key. Only `title` can go there (see above). Adding `body` to the page-component face would widen the spec (`Metadata-protocol: added`), and the `content` precedent declined that for prose of the same shape. This PR stays inside the current contract.
- The inline locale map on `body` cannot be seen by `os i18n extract` or `check:i18n-coverage`. That extractor question is a known one and is out of scope here.
- Read-only survey of the showcase pages, not fixed here and not measured in a browser: these id-less components carry copy on the bundle face, so they have no zh-CN key. `showcase_my_work`: the `object-metric` label and description ("Open Tasks", "In Review", "At-Risk Projects") and the `page:card` titles "Shortcuts" and "Leadership View". `showcase_component_gallery`: four `object-metric` blocks and an `element:button` "Create Task". `showcase_project_detail`: the `record:line_items` and `record:related_list` titles "Tasks". Several `element:text` `content` strings on those pages are plain English. Their route is the inline map, not the bundle.
